output.summary: The root problem is that billing import validation rejects AMI reads due to high consumption, causing estimation substitution and a rise in disputed bills. Evidence shows dispute ticket volume rose from ~600 in June/July to 1260 in September [E-01]; disputed bills include both ESTIMATED and ACTUAL reads [E-02]; among disputed estimated bills, 1184 had AMI reads before cutoff but were rejected for high consumption while only 56 lacked a read [E-10, E-11, E-12, E-13]; tariff change log is empty [E-04]; route completion is below target but not the primary cause [E-05, ER-1]; staffing shortage claim is unverified [E-06]; MDMS export access is provisioned [E-09]. No release was made; the gate returned HOLD, so the proposed change to the billing import validation rule in DA-RULES (SR-ADJ-RULE) was not deployed. The release was held because the completeness of DA-RULES is unknown, the semantic validity of the H-MDMS-BILL handoff is unknown, and Layer 1 verification (pagination coverage and handoff delivery semantic) failed.
key_points: Problem: billing import validation rejects AMI reads due to high consumption, causing estimation substitution and increased disputed bills [E-10, E-11, E-12, E-13] with dispute volume doubling since August [E-01].

How established: dispute volume rise [E-01]; both read types present in disputed bills [E-02]; AMI reads rejected for high consumption [E-10, E-11, E-12, E-13]; tariff log empty [E-04]; route completion below target but not primary cause [E-05, ER-1]; staffing shortage unverified [E-06]; MDMS access provisioned [E-09].
What released: No release; proposed rule adjustment in DA-RULES (SR-ADJ-RULE) held.
Why decision: Hold due to unknown completeness of DA-RULES, unknown semantic validity of H-MDMS-BILL handoff, and Layer 1 verification failure (pagination coverage, handoff delivery semantic).
Known limitations: Completeness of DA-RULES unknown; semantic validity of H-MDMS-BILL unknown; verification not established.
limitations_explained: No evidence establishes completeness of DA-RULES (data asset completeness UNKNOWN).
Semantic validity of H-MDMS-BILL handoff is UNKNOWN.
Layer 1 verification failed: pagination_coverage and handoff_delivery_semantic not satisfied.
